rationale: Jacob is building full-stack AI systems with a focus on physical robotics and perception, while Mayank specializes in robotics software engineering with expertise in computer vision and motion planning — both critical pieces for autonomous systems. They share Python and C# in their tech stacks and overlap on computer vision and robotics domains, making them natural collaborators on the infrastructure and perception challenges that bridge AI agents to physical deployment.
intro_message: Jacob Valdez, meet Mayank Bansal — you're both working on the robotics and perception side of autonomous systems, and Jacob's full-stack AI infrastructure background could complement Mayank's trajectory control and motion planning expertise.
